TASK:
Audit later decision utility and all fixed retention windows. Deliver results/experiment_8351_v720_learning_retention_audit.json. Create the thin runner scripts/experiments/experiment_8351_v720_learning_retention_audit.py. Store primitive evidence under results/raw/experiment_8351_v720_learning_retention_audit/. Future deliverables are dependencies, not existing inputs.
CONCRETE STEPS:
1. PRECONDITIONS: Emit a flushed start line. Authenticate source bytes, terminal sidecars and task authority. Check private scratch, tools and resources before work. Name missing external operands in gate_check_summary. Do not replace natural evidence with fixtures.
2. Emit a flushed progress line at every phase boundary. Emit one before and after every model load, generation, benchmark and subprocess. Print completed/pending counts inside long loops. Poll owned children at least every 60 seconds. Use unbuffered output and bounded deadlines. Keep every silence gap below 600 seconds. Write files over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines. Send a progress message between calls. No single huge tool call. Do not pad elapsed time.
3. Spec first: add relevant REQ-* and SCENARIO-* before implementation. Write focused failing tests first. Reuse existing modules through small adapters. Preserve assertions, guard thresholds and old evidence. Keep scratch in /tmp and runners in scripts/experiments/. Do not modify research-roadmap.yaml. Freeze validation commands before measurement.
4. Declare no_model_load, MODEL_SPECS=[] and zero current model calls. Identify cached verifier work or artifact aggregation as the inference_substrate. Training small numeric heads is not an LLM load.
5. Authenticate the original frozen heads/seal through Exp8346 and the complete Exp8348 trajectory. Do not require a positive H1 or H2. Read retention targets only after all windows0/32/64/96 have sealed predictions. Keep stream diagnostics from Exp8350 outside learner inputs.
6. Declare no_model_load, inference_substrate=aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts and MODEL_SPECS=[]. Reconstruct the issued trajectory, updates and checkpoint states independently. Do not import the learner's claimed gains. Read retention targets only in evaluator processes after all four shadow windows are sealed. Exp8350 may already have read these targets after the same seal; disclose that prior evaluator exposure. The learner must never receive them.
7. H2 primary is intended-slot cost(frozen_spline)-cost(online_sparse) on stream slots9..96, including missing-feature escalations. Use10000 moving-block bootstrap resamples, block length8, seed7178312, nominal one-sided97.5 percent lower bound. State explicitly that fixed exposed trajectory intervals are descriptive and do not establish an IID or conformal guarantee.
8. Report every arm on the same88 later slots, Brier, wrong-accept rate, coverage, later distinct-source probability/action changes and exact dense/sparse parity. Require >=64 qualified later sources, >=8 per label, real admitted updates, working exact-step-budget and typed-action controls, reachable margins under the actual update rule, and positive action-oracle headroom for an informative utility null. If action changes are unreachable under the fixed update budget, report complete_null_update_budget_no_headroom and limit the retirement to that update rule. No changed actions is a meaningful no-utility result when the full support/reachability conditions hold; parameter motion is not benefit.
9. A development learning signal requires mean gain>=.02 and lower bound>0 against frozen_spline, plus final retention mean cost degradation<=.02 and Brier degradation<=.01 on all available retention labels; require >=20 qualified retention sources and >=4 per label. The frozen panel has23 qualified sources,9 supported/14 unsupported; report this small exploratory panel and all9 missing slots without replacement. Show all windows0/32/64/96 and all missing bounds, without selecting a favorable window. Compare calibration_only descriptively; a win only over frozen does not establish locality-specific advantage.
10. Prove future-label invariance, duplicate/stale rejection, source separation and restart parity from primitives. Recompute one real update in a scalar reference and verify later-source attribution by substituting the before-update state. No claim of generalized learning or newly learned hard constraints.
11. Set learning_audit_ready_score for a valid reduction regardless of H2 outcome. Use complete_null_delayed_decision_benefit if supported and no gain, complete_null_insufficient_support if underpowered, blocked for absent external input, disqualified for failed owned checks. Retire the exact four-feature/fixed-knot/.01-update combination if its prior failure verdict repeats; record all mechanism limits.
12. Run relevant unit and consumer tests, scoped Ruff check/format, strict mypy and scripts/check_spec_coverage.py --files <owned-test-files>. Require 100 percent newly owned statements, including real CLI, child and failure paths. Use pytest -n 0 -o addopts= with private scratch. Record argv, exit, timing and log hashes. Do not run the full repository suite inside this experiment.
13. Cold-replay primitive evidence in a fresh process. Run valid, negative and self-consistently rehashed tamper controls. Use unchanged primary_publication checks, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Keep all findings. An exit1 requires the existing typed finding consumer: only independently recomputed informational findings with deliberate-error controls can resolve. Errors, unknown severity, warnings and critical findings block readiness. Do not edit those validators or exemption lists. Publish the terminal primary atomically after checks. Owned failures are disqualified; unchanged external blocks are blocked, never partial. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Do not update generator weights or publish externally.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind the invocation to its exact authority.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: honest_verdict starts complete_. Class is positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Partial means retryable unfinished owned work only.
gate_check_summary: principle: A block names upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected and observed values. Missing is distinct from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Separate current work from imported inference.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Retain every intended unit and condition. Repeated timings do not add independent sources.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle controls use circular_positive. Both generalization scores remain zero on exposed development.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Readiness requires byte-bound checks, not scientific success.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Bind claims to measured work and replayable inputs.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: List imported evidence and explain every added field.
learning_audit_ready_score, h2_development_signal_score, paired_cost_rows, block_bootstrap_summary: principle: Quantify later distinct-source benefit rather than updates or replay success.
retention_rows, retention_window_bounds, action_reachability, label_access_log: principle: All windows and missing targets remain visible; no favorable window selection.
